compatibilityPolicy: Existing P1/P2 JSON contracts remain supported. PALO v3 semantic contracts are additive and become the canonical source for generated public projections.

changes.summary: Introduce stable semantic identities, versioned definitions and authority classes.
changes.requiredAction: Consumers may continue using P1/P2 JSON; semantic-aware consumers should resolve the v3 catalog.

changes.summary: Separate lifecycle, phase and gate definitions from runtime gate instances.
changes.requiredAction: New runtime implementations should reference exact lifecycle and gate definition versions.

changes.summary: Add append-only gate decision records with attributable authority and digest chaining.
changes.requiredAction: Do not overwrite historical gate decisions; add a superseding record.

changes.summary: Separate artifacts, atomic claims, evaluations and bundle manifests.
changes.requiredAction: Legacy Evidence Bundle v1 remains readable; new assurance flows should emit normalized records.

changes.summary: Replace ambiguous multi-target coverage assertions with atomic versioned mappings.
changes.requiredAction: Use one mapping record per source-target pair and preserve its rationale and approval scope.

changes.summary: Pin semantic artifacts to an immutable SHA-256 release manifest.
changes.requiredAction: Assessments and new evidence manifests should record the semantic release digest used.

changes.summary: Expose semantic identity, evidence class and authority boundary without conflating them with delivery status.
changes.requiredAction: Regenerate public projections and retain explicit preview/human-review boundaries.

migrationGates: All semantic schemas and fixtures validate.
Explorer projection is deterministic and exact.
Every mapping is atomic and resolves to existing registry IDs.
Every release item digest matches its published source file.
No existing P1/P2 consumer is required to adopt RDF or JSON-LD.
